title: Exploring Transformer Backbones for Heterogeneous Treatment Effect Estimation

bias_targets.methodology: Estimating the Average Treatment Effect (ATE) of perturbing gender-associated names and pronouns on the mood state predictions of pre-trained language models (like BERT) using counterfactual sentence pairs from the Enriched Equity Evaluation Corpus (EEEC).

Estimating the Average Treatment Effect (ATE) of substituting African-American and European names on the mood state predictions of pre-trained language models using counterfactual sentence pairs from the Enriched Equity Evaluation Corpus (EEEC).
